subject: Drawing a line between two offset points by group

messages.author: d63d109921bc3c4b
messages.subject: Drawing a line between two offset points by group
parts:
Hi, I'm trying to plot two lines: one between each of two data points
that correspond to grouped data. I'm almost there but can't figure how
to get the lines to pick up the offset (dodge) I have introduced to
prevent the data points from overlapping, so any advice would be
appreciated. Here's what I have got so far:

df <- data.frame(
Timepoint = rep(c("Baseline", "Follow-up"), each = 2),
Condition = rep(c("Control", "Intervention") ),
Prevalence = c(0.3727586,0.3804704,0.3949460,0.2690871),
se_Prevalence = c(0.004905273,0.003922773,0.004305553,0.004305553)
)

library(ggplot2)

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.3)
qplot(Timepoint, Prevalence, data = df, colour = Condition,
ylim = c(0,.5), position = dodge) +
geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Prevalence - 1.96*se_Prevalence,
ymax = Prevalence + 1.96*se_Prevalence), width = 0.3, position =
dodge) +
geom_line(aes(Timepoint,Prevalence,group=Condition))
